check the optimal number of clusters 
code from: 
https://www.r-bloggers.com/finding-optimal-number-of-clusters/
author: https://www.r-bloggers.com/author/sunny-anand/
```{r, eval = FALSE}
set.seed(123)
# Compute and plot wss for k = 2 to k = 15.
k.max <- 15
data <- histone_rlog_prune
wss <- sapply(1:k.max, 
              function(k){kmeans(data, k, nstart=50,iter.max = 15 )$tot.withinss})
wss
plot(1:k.max, wss,
     type="b", pch = 19, frame = FALSE, 
     xlab="Number of clusters K",
     ylab="Total within-clusters sum of squares")

```

Average all the replicates 
```{r}
library(reshape2)
library(plyr)
histone_rlog_prune_m <- melt(as.matrix(histone_rlog_prune))
colnames(histone_rlog_prune_m) <- c("gene", "name", "value")
# looks up id from metatable and adds to new column 
histone_rlog_prune_m$id <- colData[match(histone_rlog_prune_m$name, row.names(colData)),1] 
histone_rlog_prune_mean <- dcast(histone_rlog_prune_m, gene~id, mean)
row.names(histone_rlog_prune_mean) <- histone_rlog_prune_mean$gene
histone_rlog_prune_mean$gene <- NULL

histone_rlog_prune_mean$gene <- row.names(histone_rlog_prune_mean)

histone_rlog_prune_mean_m <-  melt(histone_rlog_prune_mean, id.vars = "gene")
ggplot(histone_rlog_prune_mean_m, aes(x = value)) + 
    facet_wrap(~variable) + 
    geom_histogram(bins = 100) 
```

binarize the histones marks 

```{r, fig.width= 5, fig.height= 5}

library(parallel)
library(mclust)
library(mixtools)
source('~/Dropbox/jp_seq/binarize_counts.R')

# Calculate the number of cores
no_cores <- detectCores() - 1

# Initiate cluster
cl <- makeCluster(no_cores)

call_mclust <- function (df) {
  mclust_obj = Mclust(df$value)
  df$group <- mclust_obj$classification
  return(df)
}

call_mix_bin <- function(df) {
  bin_res <- binarize_counts(df$value)
  df$group <- bin_res$bin
  return(df)
}

clusterExport(cl, list( "call_mclust", "binarize_counts", "call_mix_bin"))
clusterEvalQ(cl, list(library(mclust), library(mixtools), library(ggplot2)))



histone_rlog_prune_mean_l <- split(histone_rlog_prune_mean_m, as.factor(histone_rlog_prune_mean_m$variable))
  
histone_rlog_prune_mclust <- parLapply(cl, histone_rlog_prune_mean_l, call_mclust)
histone_rlog_prune_bin <- parLapply(cl, histone_rlog_prune_mean_l, call_mix_bin)

stopCluster(cl)

histone_rlog_prune_mclust_m <- dplyr::bind_rows(histone_rlog_prune_mclust)  
histone_rlog_prune_bin_m <- dplyr::bind_rows(histone_rlog_prune_bin)  

hist_breaks <- seq(0, 1, by = 0.02)
n <- dim(histone_rlog_prune_mean)[1]


ggplot(histone_rlog_prune_mclust_m, aes(value)) + 
  #geom_histogram(aes(y = ..count..), bins = 50, alpha = 0.5, position="identity" ) #+ 
  geom_histogram(aes(y = ..count..), colour = "black", fill = "grey", breaks = hist_breaks, alpha = 0.8) +
  #geom_density(data = h3k27me3, aes(colour = factor(h3k27me3_group), fill = factor(h3k27me3_group)), alpha = 0.3) 
  geom_density(aes(y =..density..*(n * 0.02),colour = factor(group), fill = factor(group)), alpha = 0.3)  + 
  facet_wrap(~variable)


ggplot(histone_rlog_prune_bin_m, aes(value)) + 
  #geom_histogram(aes(y = ..count..), bins = 50, alpha = 0.5, position="identity" ) #+ 
  geom_histogram(aes(y = ..count..), colour = "black", fill = "grey", breaks = hist_breaks, alpha = 0.8) +
  #geom_density(data = h3k27me3, aes(colour = factor(h3k27me3_group), fill = factor(h3k27me3_group)), alpha = 0.3) 
  geom_density(aes(y =..density..*(n * 0.02),colour = factor(group), fill = factor(group)), alpha = 0.3)  + 
  facet_wrap(~variable) + 
  theme(legend.position = "bottom", 
          legend.direction = "horizontal",
          legend.box.just	= "top",
          legend.box = "horizontal", 
          panel.spacing = unit(2, "lines"))


histone_mclust <- histone_rlog_prune_mclust_m %>%
  dplyr::select(-value) %>%
  tidyr::spread(key = variable, value = group )

histone_bin <- histone_rlog_prune_bin_m %>%
  dplyr::select(-value) %>%
  tidyr::spread(key = variable, value = group )


```

enh_cor_start_all$GNP_H3K4me1_rep2.category <- factor(enh_cor_start_all$GNP_H3K4me1_rep2.category, levels = enh_labels)

The reduced RNAseq timecourse by histone TSNE plot

toc_t50 is from the RNAseq features v4
toc_t50_histones chooses the rowMax histone from the table 

```{r}
library(ggplot2)
source('~/Dropbox/jp_seq/line_scatter_facet.R')
source('~/Dropbox/jp_seq/plot_group_timeline.R')

 
load("~/Dropbox/GNP_MB_integrate/2016_06_18_integration/log2_norm_list_2017_01_09.RData")

toc_t50_histones <- read.table("~/Dropbox/GNP_MB_integrate/2016_06_18_integration/toc_t50_histones_2018_05_25.txt", sep = "\t", row.names = 1, header = TRUE)
toc_t50 <- read.table("~/Dropbox/GNP_MB_integrate/2016_06_18_integration/toc_t50_2018_05_25.txt", sep = "\t", row.names = 1, header = TRUE)
enh_quant <- read.table("~/Dropbox/GNP_MB_integrate/2016_06_18_integration/enhancer_dist_quant.txt", sep = "\t", row.names = 1, header = TRUE)


pseudo_time <- c("E15","P0", "P1", "P7", "P12", "P14", "P18", "P21", "P56")

gnp_v1_anno <- read.table("~/Dropbox/GNP_MB_integrate/2016_06_18_integration/gnp_v1_annotation.txt", sep = "\t",  header = TRUE)
head(gnp_v1_anno)
table(row.names(histone_rlog_prune) == gnp_v1_anno$keep_transcript)
# add annotation 
toc_t50_ano <- merge(x = gnp_v1_anno, y = toc_t50, by.x = "ensembl_gene_id", by.y = "ensembl_gene_id", all.y = TRUE)


# clean table 
toc_t50_ano$chromosome_name <- toc_t50_ano$chromosome_name.x 
toc_t50_ano$chromosome_name.x <- NULL
toc_t50_ano$chromosome_name.y <- NULL
toc_t50_ano$Row.names <- NULL




histone_promoter <- histone_rlog_prune 
histone_promoter$promoter_histone_sum <- rowSums(histone_rlog_prune)
#colnames(histone_rlog_prune_mean) <- str_c(colnames(histone_rlog_prune_mean), "_mean")

histone_promoter <- cbind(histone_promoter, histone_rlog_prune_mean)


# merge promoter and enhancer data 
histone_promoter_enh <- merge(x = histone_promoter, y = histones_enh, by.x = 0, by.y = 0, all = TRUE)
row.names(histone_promoter_enh) <- histone_promoter_enh$Row.names 
histone_promoter_enh$Row.names <- NULL

# merge enhancer quants 
histone_promoter_enh <- merge(x = histone_promoter_enh, y = enh_quant, by.x = 0, by.y = 0, all.x = TRUE)
row.names(histone_promoter_enh) <- histone_promoter_enh$Row.names 
histone_promoter_enh$Row.names <- NULL

# to get the toc_t50 replicated for each TSS we have promo
histones_promoter_enh_ano <- merge(x = gnp_v1_anno, y = histone_promoter_enh, by.x = "keep_transcript", by.y = 0, all.y = TRUE)
histone_k_toc_t50_ano <- merge(x = histones_promoter_enh_ano, y = toc_t50_ano[,-c(2:8)], by.x = "ensembl_gene_id", by.y = "ensembl_gene_id", all = FALSE)

dim(histone_k_toc_t50_ano)
table(duplicated(histone_k_toc_t50_ano$keep_transcript))
histone_k_toc_t50_ano <- histone_k_toc_t50_ano[!duplicated(histone_k_toc_t50_ano$keep_transcript),]

histone_k_toc_t50_ano <- histone_k_toc_t50_ano[!is.na(histone_k_toc_t50_ano$expr),]
histone_k_toc_t50 <-  histone_k_toc_t50_ano

```

library(GGally)

#histone_rlog_prune_mean <- read.table("~/Dropbox/GNP_MB_integrate/2016_06_18_integration/histone_K36_RNAseq_prune_mean.txt", header = TRUE, row.names = 1, sep = "\t")

                                   by.x = 0, by.y = 0, all= FALSE )
row.names(histone_rlog_prune_mean_k) <- histone_rlog_prune_mean_k$Row.names
histone_rlog_prune_mean_k$Row.names <- NULL 
p <- GGally::ggpairs(histone_rlog_prune_mean_k, 
                columns = c(2:11), 
                #mapping = ggplot2::aes(color = data_k), 
                lower = list(continuous = wrap("points", alpha = 0.3, size=0.1), mapping = aes(color = data_k)) )



                #upper = list(continuous = wrap("cor", size = 1)))

# to solve the colour manual issues used code from 
# http://stackoverflow.com/questions/34740210/how-to-change-the-color-palette-for-ggallyggpairs
for(i in 1:p$nrow) {
  for(j in 1:p$ncol){
    p[i,j] <- p[i,j] + 
        scale_colour_manual(values = data_colors) +
        scale_fill_manual(values = data_colors)  
  }
}

p

    scale_alpha_manual(values = c( "differentiation" = 1, "other" = 0.1)) +
      scale_size(range = c(0.01,3)) + 
   #scale_size_manual(values = c( "differentiation" = 1, "other" = 0.5)) +
  theme()

sce_agg_merged_cc_ann %>% 
  dplyr::mutate(data_k = as.factor(data_k)) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(diff_gene = case_when(
      ensembl_gene %in%  diff_genes$ensembl_gene    ~  "differentiation",
      TRUE                             ~  "other"
  )) %>%

   scale_colour_manual(values = c( "differentiation" = "red", "other" = "grey")) +

      scale_size(range = c(0.01,3)) +

  theme()

sce_agg_merged_cc_ann %>% 
  #dplyr::filter(max_t50_avgfc_cat %in%

   dplyr::mutate(avg_fc = as.numeric(Winsorize(avg_fc, minval = 1, maxval = 6))) %>%

```{r}
library(xgboost)
library(caret)
library(data.table)

data = pred_mat

#make this example reproducible
set.seed(0)

#split into training (80%) and testing set (20%)
parts = createDataPartition(data$target, p = .8, list = F)
train = data[parts, ]
test = data[-parts, ]

setDT(train) 
setDT(test)

#using one hot encoding 
labels <- train$target
ts_label <- test$target
new_tr <- model.matrix(~.+0,data = train[,-c("target"),with=F]) 
new_ts <- model.matrix(~.+0,data = test[,-c("target"),with=F])

#convert factor to numeric 
labels <- as.numeric(labels)
ts_label <- as.numeric(ts_label)


#preparing matrix 
dtrain <- xgb.DMatrix(data = new_tr,label = labels) 
dtest <- xgb.DMatrix(data = new_ts,label=ts_label)


#default parameters
params <- list(booster = "gbtree", objective = "binary:logistic", eta=0.3, gamma=2, max_depth=6, min_child_weight=1, subsample=1, colsample_bytree=1, scale_pos_weight = 70)


xgbcv <- xgb.cv( params = params, data = dtrain, nrounds = 200, nfold = 5, showsd = T, stratified = T, print_every_n = 10, early_stopping_rounds = 20, maximize = F)
##best iteration = 7

min(xgbcv$test.error.mean)


#first default - model training
xgb1 <- xgb.train (params = params, data = dtrain, nrounds = 1000, watchlist = list(val=dtest,train=dtrain), print.every.n = 10, early.stop.round = 50, maximize = F , eval_metric = "auc", nthread = 2)
#model prediction
xgbpred <- predict (xgb1,dtest)
xgbpred <- ifelse (xgbpred > 0.5,1,0)

library(caret)
confusionMatrix (as.factor(xgbpred), as.factor(ts_label))
#Accuracy - 86.54%` 

#view variable importance plot
mat <- xgb.importance (feature_names = colnames(new_tr),model = xgb1)
xgb.plot.importance (importance_matrix = mat[1:20]) 
#xgb.dump(xgb1, with_stats = TRUE)

```

# Attach Packages
library(tidyverse)    # data manipulation and visualization
library(kernlab)      # SVM methodology
library(e1071)        # SVM methodology
library(ISLR)         # contains example data set "Khan"
library(RColorBrewer) # customized coloring of plots
library(doParallel)

# construct larger random data set
x <- matrix(rnorm(200*2), ncol = 2)
x[1:100,] <- x[1:100,] + 2.5
x[101:150,] <- x[101:150,] - 2.5
y <- c(rep(1,150), rep(2,50))
dat <- data.frame(x=x,y=as.factor(y))

# Plot data
ggplot(data = dat, aes(x = x.2, y = x.1, color = y, shape = y)) + 
  geom_point(size = 2) +
  scale_color_manual(values=c("#000000", "#FF0000")) +
  theme(legend.position = "none")

# set pseudorandom number generator
set.seed(123)

data$target <- as.factor(data$target)

# sample training data and fit model
svmfit <- svm(target ~ H3K27me3 + Ring1b ,  data = train[, c("H3K27me3", "Ring1b", "target")], kernel = "radial", gamma = 10, cost = 1)


# plot classifier

plot(svmfit, formula = H3K27me3 ~ Ring1b, data=train[, c("H3K27me3", "Ring1b", "target")])

table(svmfit$fitted, train$target)

ypred <- predict(svmfit, train)
(misclass <- table(predict = ypred, truth = train$target))


svmfit <- svm(target ~ H3K27me3 + Ring1b + H3K4me3 ,  data = train[, c("H3K27me3", "Ring1b", "H3K4me3", "target")], kernel = "radial", gamma = 1000, cost = 1)

plot(svmfit, formula = H3K27me3 ~ Ring1b, data=train[, c("H3K27me3", "Ring1b", "H3K4me3" , "target")])

plot(svmfit, formula = H3K27me3 ~ H3K4me3, data=train[, c("H3K27me3", "Ring1b", "H3K4me3" , "target")])


test$target <- as.factor(test$target)
table(svmfit$fitted, train$target)

ypred <- predict(svmfit, test)
(misclass <- table(predict = ypred, truth = test$target))

confusionMatrix(ypred, test$target)


tt <- train[,c("H3K27me3", "Ring1b", "target")]
tt$target <- as.factor(tt$target )

train$target <- as.factor(train$target)

svmfit <- svm(target ~ H3K27me3 + Ring1b + H3K4me3 ,  data = train, kernel = "radial", gamma = 1, cost = 1)

plot(svmfit, train, H3K27me3 ~ Ring1b)
plot(svmfit, train, H3K27me3 ~ H3K4me3)

ypred <- predict(svmfit, train)
(misclass <- table(predict = ypred, truth = train$target))
